output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, causing a potential overflow if initialSupply is very large.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; statement can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[msg.sender], causing a buyout of the balanceOf[msg.sender].

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; statement can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[_from], causing a buyout of the balanceOf[_from].

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount; statement can underflow if amount is larger than balanceOf[msg.sender], causing a buyout of the balanceOf[msg.sender].
